notes:
- The version for every quote below is commit 3a5d5326c9a16e368c4cb5731cc5fcf3653d60b1. The npm `billion-context` version at that commit was not read, because package.json could not be fetched. `mcp__github__get_file_contents` was denied for this repo, so the source came from `search_code` plus a raw.githubusercontent fetch via Exa.
- The file was read in segments, lines 50-80, 440-520 and 625-1020 of 2592; the settings/hook/MCP/command code is all in lines 460-1020. The raw dump is at /root/.claude/projects/-home-user-holyagent/e4ac10e5-b710-572b-aa70-34045c8c8d11/tool-results/mcp-Exa-web_fetch_exa-1793290839355.txt.
- Only one source (the project's own code) supports these quotes, apart from `commands/bili-setup.md` and `CLIENTS.zh-CN.md`, which agree on the `/acp-cache` command, the env keys and the MCP tools.
- The template can change across releases. Ownership in bili is by content (exact template for the command, script-name regex for the hook). For acp-cache.md, the safest `holyagent setup claude` marker is an exact-body match, or this distinctive first-line text: `description: billion-context prompt-cache reconciliation report (same as the acp_cache tool)`. A bare `billion-context` / `bili` substring is looser.
- The command path honors `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. When it is set, `settings.json` and `commands/` are read from that directory, but the MCP entry still lives in `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR>/.claude.json` via `homeFile(".claude.json","CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR")`.
- bili also writes a `settings.json.bili-bak` backup, and `.bili-bak` can hold a pre-install `DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` that bili restores on remove.
- On remove, bili deletes `DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` only when it equals "1". It deletes `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL` only when they match `isBiliClaudeBaseUrl`.

evidence:
1. commands/acp-cache.md content (src/plugin-install.ts lines 484-490, const `CLAUDE_ACP_CACHE_COMMAND`, path from `claudeAcpCacheCommandFile` lines 492-496: `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR|~/.claude>/commands/acp-cache.md`). Exact body:
```
---
description: billion-context prompt-cache reconciliation report (same as the acp_cache tool)
---
Run the `acp_cache` tool provided by the `bili` MCP server now. If the arguments below contain the word "full", call it with detail:"full"; otherwise call it with no arguments. Then paste the tool's complete output verbatim in a fenced code block — do not summarize, translate, reorder, or omit anything. If the tool is unavailable, reply exactly: bili: acp_cache tool not available (is the bili MCP server registered?)

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
```
Install writes the file only if it is absent or equals this template (`trimEnd` compare), lines 942-948. Remove deletes it only on an exact match (`content.trimEnd() === CLAUDE_ACP_CACHE_COMMAND.trimEnd()`), lines 989-999.

2. Hook (lines 53-79, 614, 671-681, 685-718, 876, 891-892). In `settings.json` it adds `hooks.SessionStart` += `{ hooks: [{ type: "command", command: <hookCommand> }] }` (line 674). The command is `portableHookCommand("node", [path.join(root,"dist","claude-native-bootstrap.js")])`, which yields `node <forward-slash path>/dist/claude-native-bootstrap.js` (a bare `node` token; tests/hook-command.test.ts shows the form `D:/Dev/node/node.exe C:/Users/u/AppData/Local/Temp/bili/claude-native-bootstrap.js`). Ownership regex (line 688): `/claude-native-bootstrap\.(?:js|mjs|ts)["']?$/` on the hook command; an entry is ours if any hook in it matches.

3. MCP server entry (lines 912, 861-862, 1007-1008). Install runs `claude mcp add bili --scope user -e BILI_MCP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:<port> -- <process.execPath> <root>/dist/claude-mcp-entry.js`. This writes `mcpServers.bili` in `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR|~>/.claude.json` with `command` = node, `args` containing `dist/claude-mcp-entry.js`, and `env.BILI_MCP_PROXY`. Ownership: command basename matches `node(.exe|.cmd)?` and an arg matches `/dist[\\/]claude-mcp-entry\.(?:js|mjs)$/`. Legacy installs used an arg `/dist[\\/]mcp\.(?:js|mjs)$/` and are migrated. Remove runs `claude mcp remove bili --scope user`.

4. Settings env keys (lines 634-668, 729-745, 502-505). `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is set to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/bili/<upstream>`, matched by `/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:\d{1,5}\/bili\/(?:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\/)?https?:\/\//`. `env.DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` is set to `"1"`. `env.ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL` is set only on a Vertex lane, with the same /bili/ pattern. A foreign value of any of these is left untouched.
